sources.note: Nothing. States the former language is known only from words and phrases an arrow-poison trader recalled (with difficulty, ~30 years later) from a 1959 visit to Mkoseka; six of the obscure words are listed (sako, sakaya, gobina, mada, mat̠indo, bulabula); half the material resembled Waata (Oromo). Present-day Degere speak Duruma/Digo (Mijikenda).
